Description: Bound: Token is bound to the device (observed for bound sign-ins; not listed in Microsoft's documentation).
Unbound: No Microsoft Entra ID device state (device not registered).
Unbound: Device state doesn't meet token protection requirements (unsupported registration type or legacy registration).
Unbound: Not hardware-backed and signed-in user isn't the registered device owner.
Unbound: Client isn't integrated with the platform broker (e.g. WAM) or broker app isn't installed.
